name: Chiyoko Parfait
source:
Works at the shopping center.

She's a carefree clothing store employee who came from overseas. She's confident in her own looks and always focused on enhancing her appearance. She uses that experience to help other girls look cute at her job. Seeing other people's smiles gives her fulfillment.

Her broken Japanese gives her a foreigner vibe.

[Translate from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/23.html]official website[/url]]
